topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I had planned it all, you see. The balloons—the paper kind, with whispers of celebration inside. The cake, too, its layers heavy with the weight of surprise. I had woven your name into the air, a private constellation of happiness hanging from the ceiling, waiting for you. But the room grew too full of echoes and the shadows started whispering, changing the script, erasing the ink with which I'd penned the invitations. Now, the constellation flickers, uncertain. I wished to make this moment as bright as the stars, but the night has clouded over without warning. The party can wait, I tell myself, as the cake stands, a lonely moon in my silent kitchen.
